news.title: 25 Years After 9/11, a Portrait of Muslim Americans
news.summary_en: Some Americans still see Muslims through the lens of the terrorist attacks. Yet Muslims are a growing, vibrant part of the country’s political and religious landscape.

news.title: 9/11 memories remain vivid in the U.S. 25 years later
news.summary_en: While 9/11 remains vivid in most Americans’ memories, 10% of adults today were born after the attacks and learned about the day’s events from others.

news.title: Americans have grown more skeptical that a woman will be president in their lifetime
news.summary_en: Some 37% of Americans now say it’s not too or not at all likely that the United States will elect a woman as president, up from 26% in 2023.
